title: croffasia/itsaplan: a self-hosted board where agents take tickets
friendlyTitle: It's a Plan: a self-hosted ticket board where agents can take work
summary: It's a Plan is a self-hosted issue tracker on today's TypeScript trending list, with about 1,600 stars. It has projects, boards, cycles, and an API. The difference it advertises is that an agent can have a role, permissions, and an assignee slot on the same board as people, and can be reached over REST, webhooks, and MCP. The main licence is AGPL-3.0.
friendlySummary: It's a Plan is a self-hosted issue tracker on today's TypeScript trending list, with about 1,600 stars. It has projects, boards, cycles, and an API. The feature it advertises is that an AI agent can have a role, permissions, and an assignee slot on the same board as people. Agents can be reached through a normal API, webhooks, and MCP. The main licence is AGPL-3.0.
whyItMatters: Use it if you want the ticket board on your own server, and you want an agent to pick up an issue without sending the project to a hosted tracker. You can also run it as an ordinary board and leave the agents off.
